record.paper_title: Why Agentic Theorem Prover Works: A Statistical Provability Theory of Mathematical Reasoning Models

claims.evidence: Twenty random six-state measures and bounded TV distances do not test compactness or the bounded-Lipschitz topology.
Backward induction on a six-state finite MDP does not instantiate the Feller continuity conditions.
Functions constructed around V* on the same six-state MDP are circular and small-scale.
Regret was constant and accepted using an extra +0.5 tolerance.
The margin condition was not instantiated and the observed slope was zero.
The script evaluated the displayed formula instead of empirical estimation error.

record.overall: The numerical checks are toy or proxy checks and do not verify the six theoretical claims.
